title: Senior Manager, Managed Services
jobDescription: The Senior Manager, Managed Services is responsible for leading multiple teams, service areas, or regional delivery operations. This role oversees customer relationships, service quality, escalations, operational performance, resource planning, and continuous improvement across a broader Managed Services scope. Ensures Managed Services commitments are delivered across multiple teams, customers, or regions. Improves service performance by managing SLA/KPI results, escalations, recurring issues, and operational risks. Coordinates resource capability, workload, staffing plans, and cross-functional delivery priorities. Drives improvements in service quality, customer satisfaction, utilization, and operational efficiency. Uses AI-enabled analytics to identify patterns across incidents, customer escalations, team performance, and service delivery risks. Leadership/Accountability Manages multiple teams, team leads, service owners, or managers depending on organizational structure. Accountable for customer delivery quality, team performance, operational governance, and service reporting. Responsible for performance management, talent development, succession planning, hiring input, and capability building. Owns improvement actions for underperformance, customer dissatisfaction, SLA misses, and delivery gaps. Accountable for ensuring AI-assisted analysis is accurate, governed, and used responsibly in operational decisions. Communication/Leadership Communicates service performance, risks, priorities, and actions to customers, leadership, SDMs, account teams, and technical teams. Provides clear leadership across teams and removes blockers that impact delivery. Manages escalations with urgency, structure, and commercial awareness. Builds alignment across regions, customers, and internal stakeholders. Uses AI to improve service review content, management dashboards, escalation summaries, and leadership communication. Experience Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in IT services, Managed Services, customer operations, or service delivery. Typically 5+ years of people management experience, including leadership of multiple teams, service areas, or complex delivery functions. Proven ability to manage service delivery across customers, regions, time zones, and technical domains. Strong understanding of operational governance, service metrics, resource planning, customer success, and financial performance. Uses approved AI tools to support cross-team analytics, service trend analysis, capacity planning, escalation review, and executive reporting. Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Software Engineer - AIML
jobDescription: About Kaleris and the Role Lead the architecture and delivery of scalable ML/RL systems at Kaleris. As a Senior AIML Software Engineer, you’ll set technical standards, mentor engineers, and drive initiatives from problem framing through production operations, shaping AI solutions that materially improve throughput, cost, and service reliability for global supply chains. What You’ll Do Architect end-to-end ML/RL platforms: pipelines, training/evaluation environments, model serving, monitoring, and incident response. Establish data quality standards, observability, and governance across ML products. Optimize production workflows for performance, latency, scalability, and security. Lead technical reviews, elevate code/design quality, and ensure reproducible experimentation. Partner cross-functionally to translate business goals into model objectives, success metrics, and deployment strategies. Mentor and coach engineers and data scientists; promote best practices and continuous improvement. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s/Master’s/Ph D in Computer Science or related field; 5–8+ years building and operating ML systems in production. Advanced proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (Py Torch or Tensor Flow). Experience building enterprise applications with Java and Spring Boot. Expert-level experience with scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, and machine learning model development and evaluation. Proven track record deploying on Azure/AWS/GCP; strong with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD. Hands-on experience with monitoring, drift detection, alerting, and incident response for ML services. Preferred Qualifications Simulation expertise (discrete-event or agent-based), queueing/stochastic modeling, and reinforcement learning in real-world settings. MLOps depth: model versioning, experiment tracking, automated retraining, governance. Logistics/supply chain domain experience and optimization in complex/partially observable environments. Experience with serverless functions and event-driven architectures for low-latency model APIs, including Knative, Azure Functions, and AWS Lambda Why Kaleris Own strategic ML initiatives with direct line-of-sight to customer impact. Influence product direction and technical standards in a modern AI/ML organization. Competitive salary and benefits; inclusive culture; opportunities to grow scope and leadership. title: Senior Application Engineer
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Application Monitoring & Performance Management Lead continuous monitoring and advanced diagnostics of N4 TOS performance, integrations, logs, and system behaviour across Production, DR, Test, and Dev environments. Identify application bottlenecks, configuration gaps, and operational risks before they impact terminal performance. Perform periodical health checks, assessment and optimization N4 TOS software for better performance Recommend and implement performance improvement actions. Advanced Troubleshooting & Incident Management Serve as the senior escalation point for complex N4 TOS application incidents. Troubleshoot and resolve high-severity issues involving application configuration, jobs, transactions, workflows, and integrations. Perform root cause analysis on critical issues and repeated incidents, implement controls to prevent them. Participate in 24×7 standby rotation for P1s and major incident response. Customer Consulting & Best-Practice Guidance Provide expert consulting to customers regarding N4 TOS functionality, configuration, operational workflows, and integrations. Conduct configuration reviews, SOP validation, operational health checks, and upgrade-readiness assessments. Lead customer discussions, explain root causes, and drive alignment on corrective and preventive actions. Monthly operational inputs to periodical service review connects with customer Configuration Management & Operational Support Review, validate, and optimize customer software setups to align with Kaleris standards. Support controlled changes, deployments, extensions, and application parameter updates. Collaborate with DB, Infra, EDI, and Support teams to resolve cross-functional issues. Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Leadership Document issue patterns, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and best practices. Mentor junior engineers and apprentices, enabling skill uplift across teams. Contribute to automation opportunities, monitoring improvements, and diagnostics enhancements. Qualifications & Experience Required Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent. 6–8 years of experience supporting mission-critical enterprise applications in a production environment. Strong understanding of: Application architecture Logs and monitoring Workflow configuration Application interfaces and job execution Proven ability to troubleshoot complex application performance and stability issues. Desired / Advantageous Hands-on experience with N4 Terminal Operating System (TOS) application support. Hands-on EDI experience in enterprise software, logistics, maritime, or supply chain environments. Experience in the maritime / logistics / supply chain domain. Background working directly with customers in consulting, support, or managed services roles. Good understanding of related infrastructure (DB, EDI, networking, Linux/Windows). Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong analytical, diagnostic, and root-cause analysis skills. Excellent communication and customer-facing consulting skills. Ability to manage high-pressure incidents and competing priorities. Highly organized with strong multitasking and time-management abilities. High ownership mentality; proactive in preventing issues rather than reacting. Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed global teams. Strong documentation and follow-up discipline. High energy, professionalism, and commitment to quality. Multilingual proficiency is a plus. Required to support 24×7 operations and work in shifts when required. Summary This senior-level role is ideal for an experienced application engineer who thrives in fast-paced, mission-critical environments and wants to play a key role in ensuring stable, high-performing N4 TOS operations for global Kaleris customers. title: Systems Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary The Systems Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining the company’s end-user computing environment. This includes installing, configuring, and troubleshooting desktops, laptops, printers, and related systems while ensuring compliance with IT standards and security policies. The role provides Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support to users and collaborates with network and systems teams to ensure stable and secure operations. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, and support desktops, laptops, printers, and other end-user devices. Perform software installations, updates, and patch management across user systems. Troubleshoot hardware and software issues for on-site and remote users. Manage user accounts, permissions, and policies through Active Directory and Office
365. Assist in deploying standard desktop images and maintaining compliance with IT policies. Ensure endpoint security through antivirus, encryption, and update compliance. Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support for user incidents and escalate complex issues as needed. Maintain accurate asset inventory and ensure proper tracking of IT equipment. Collaborate with network and systems teams to resolve connectivity and performance issues. Support onboarding and offboarding processes, including hardware setup and access provisioning. Qualifications 2–4 years of IT or systems support experience. Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office
365. Hands-on experience with Active Directory administration. Familiarity with endpoint management and patching tools. Understanding of basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi). Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills. Certifications such as Comp TIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft-related credentials preferred. Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer.
